messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — SOC2 needs explicit retention proof for audit logs that include envelope key IDs. We were asked for a sample 90-day export + owner for the KMS -> audit-ingest path. Who owns end-to-end here? cc @Sam @Anika

Sam: I can take ownership of the KMS side (key metadata + rotation proofs). I need someone from logging to confirm the ingest preserves key_id.

Anika: Logging team here. We ingest key_id in the event payload but need to validate it survives the Kafka -> processor transform. I'll run a quick spot-check.

Leo: I can help with the processor side. Last week we changed the schema (added envelope.algorithm) — possible we dropped key_id in one branch. Will check git history.

Sam: Thanks. To unblock auditors, can we produce a small export with both KMS attest and matching log lines? Preferably before EOD Friday.

Anika: Agreed. I'll run a sampling query now and post results. If Leo can confirm the transform, we can stitch them together.

Anika: (after a few mins) Quick sample shows key_id present in raw topic for 2026-03-10..2026-03-16. Will paste query.

Anika: ```sql
SELECT key_id, event_type, ts FROM raw_audit_topic WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-16' LIMIT 50;
```

Sam: Nice. On KMS side I'll generate attestation for those key_ids — rotation history + envelope metadata. Expect a tarball link in ~2h.

Leo: Checked the processor branch: a conditional branch flattened the payload and accidentally renamed `envelope.keyId` -> `envelope_key`. I'll open a tiny PR to preserve `key_id` field and add a migration check.

Anika: Thanks — once PR is up ping me and I'll re-run queries against the processed topic.

Sam: OpsBot — please create an evidence ticket and link KMS attestation + logging export once ready.

OpsBot: Created ticket https://tracker.internal/SEC-9421 with tags [soc2,evidence,kms,logs]. Assigned to Sam, Anika, Leo. ETA field: 2026-03-20.

Maria: Perfect. To clarify owners: Sam = KMS attestation, Anika = raw ingest export + verification, Leo = transform fix + processed export. Maria will coordinate evidence upload to the audit bucket.

Sam: One more ask — auditors may request a reproducible query. I'll add the KMS commands used (CLI + flags) in SEC-9421.

Anika: If anyone hits missing key_ids after Leo's fix, tag me and I'll run a backfill spot-check.

Leo: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/processor/pulls/318 — small rename + unit test. Requesting review from @Anika.

Anika: Reviewing now. If green, I'll run processed-topic check and attach CSV to the ticket.

Maria: Thanks all. Quick sync: deliverables = (1) KMS attestation tarball (Sam), (2) raw-topic CSV (Anika), (3) processed-topic CSV + PR link (Leo), (4) ticket SEC-9421 populated and evidence uploaded (Maria). Target: EOD Friday. Please update SEC-9421 with any blockers. :thumbsup:

Sam: On it.

Anika: Will update in ~90m.

Leo: Will follow up after PR CI.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-19 10:00 UTC in channel.
